scope: Offline candidates only: dense/hybrid top8 do NOT measure complete compiled-prompt admission or live model quality.
experiment: RP263; frozen before model evaluation; no post-holdout tuning
decision: Do not integrate this model/RRF configuration into gameplay. It regresses retrieval and unknown-query controls.

method.lexical: current lexical top8, before whole-prompt admission
method.hybrid: fixed equal-weight RRF k=60, top8; explicit owner/ambiguous identity retains baseline
method.first: first entry of each method; compiled baseline ordering differs from lexical candidate priority
method.controls: gold empty is not scored as recall success; control drift measures hybrid vs compiled baseline

environment.runtimeBytesMeaning: installed .pnpm directory logical file bytes, includes distributed platform binaries; excludes global pnpm store and model files

offlineCold.scope: Node fetch/http/https/net blocked. Process RSS/wall time include Vite benchmark preparation. OS disconnection and browser inference not tested.

cacheWarm.scope: 424 ready vectors read; no model inference. Full wall time includes fixture compilation.

sanity.explanation: q8 padding/batch may alter numerical outputs; benchmark uses one input at a time consistently. Repeated single-input runs are identical on this PC.
